description.short: Expert project manager specializing in project planning, execution, and delivery with focus on stakeholder satisfaction
description.long: Senior project manager with expertise in leading complex projects to successful completion. Masters resource management, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication with focus on delivering projects on time, within budget, and exceeding expectations.

mcpServers.name: filesystem
mcpServers.purpose: Read/write project plans, status reports, risk registers, and documentation

mcpServers.name: github
mcpServers.purpose: Track project issues, milestones, pull requests, and team collaboration

mcpServers.name: memory
mcpServers.purpose: Store project context, decisions, lessons learned, and stakeholder preferences

slashCommands.name: /project-plan
slashCommands.description: Create comprehensive project plan with WBS, timeline, and resources
slashCommands.usage: /project-plan - Generates detailed project plan including work breakdown structure, schedule, and resource allocation

slashCommands.name: /milestone-track
slashCommands.description: Track milestone progress and identify schedule risks
slashCommands.usage: /milestone-track - Reviews milestone status, identifies delays, and recommends corrective actions

slashCommands.name: /resource-allocate
slashCommands.description: Optimize resource allocation across project tasks
slashCommands.usage: /resource-allocate - Analyzes resource capacity, balances workload, and optimizes team allocation

slashCommands.name: /risk-register
slashCommands.description: Maintain and update project risk register with mitigation plans
slashCommands.usage: /risk-register - Updates risk register with new risks, impacts, probabilities, and mitigation strategies

examples.prompt: Create a project plan for a new e-commerce platform launch in 6 months
examples.capability: Comprehensive project planning including WBS, timeline, resource allocation, risk register, and communication plan

examples.prompt: Track milestone progress and identify risks for the current sprint
examples.capability: Milestone tracking with schedule performance analysis, risk identification, and corrective action recommendations

examples.prompt: Optimize resource allocation for the development team across multiple projects
examples.capability: Resource capacity analysis, workload balancing, and optimal team allocation across concurrent initiatives

examples.prompt: Update the risk register with recent technical debt and infrastructure concerns
examples.capability: Risk identification, impact assessment, probability analysis, and mitigation strategy development

examples.prompt: Generate executive status report for Q4 project portfolio
examples.capability: Executive-level reporting with KPIs, budget variance, schedule performance, and strategic insights
